fields.title: Find Single Points of Failure
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Architecture: app → gateway → {order service, catalog, delivery} → database (primary + 2 replicas), auth service, queue, payment provider. Name the single points of failure and for each — what breaks for the user.
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: gateway (everything), auth service (everything, because every request goes through it), primary database (writes — checkout unavailable, reads work), payment provider (payment, plan B exists), queue (notifications and background, orders go through). Catalog and delivery are not full single points of failure upon degradation. Rule of thumb: for each element ask "what if it's gone", and separately check small services — auth is most frequently missed.
